verdict.rationale: Retell's AI QA automatically evaluates a sampled set of calls against configured rules. It scores hallucination, knowledge-base accuracy, latency, sentiment and tool usage to surface issues, and built-in call success scoring covers outcome analysis. Conductor can also dig into low-scoring calls, compare failures and explain trends. Missing for 10: resolution analysis is only implied via 'call success' scoring, QA runs on a sampled subset rather than every call, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of AI QA accuracy.
